content: Hello, I am Meridian Bank's digital assistant. This call is recorded. Am I speaking with Mx Alexis Dale?
No, I'm not Alexis. I'm the office manager and I usually handle the paperwork for these accounts, so how can I help?
I can discuss this with Mx Dale alone. When can Mx Dale be reached?
Understood. Alexis will be available tomorrow at 10:00, so could you call back then, or is there another way they should get in touch with you?
Your callback is booked. Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
